headline: Anthropic confirms Claude Code blocks video game cloning, reverse-engineering
summary: Anthropic updated Claude so it refuses to recreate existing video games, and an Anthropic employee later confirmed Claude Code carries explicit instructions against reproducing game IP while still allowing original designs. Users report the restriction also catches non-malicious reverse-engineering work. Early coverage attributed the behavior to the Opus 5.5 model generally; later reporting ties it specifically to Claude Code's system prompt.
